create_RoIDataLoader: create a RoIDataLoader instance with a roidb and configure the number of loader threads and queue sizes
start_RoIDataLoader: start the RoIDataLoader worker and enqueuer threads with an optional prefill of the minibatch queue
shutdown_RoIDataLoader: shutdown the RoIDataLoader by requesting stop, waiting for threads, and closing blobs queues
enqueue_blobs_RoIDataLoader: enqueue blobs onto a GPU BlobsQueue by feeding them into the Caffe2 workspace and running SafeEnqueueBlobs
register_sigint_handler_RoIDataLoader: register a SIGINT signal handler on the RoIDataLoader to gracefully shutdown threads on interrupt
